sources.name: march-se
sources.annotationMethod: Fresh manually estimated concealed pelvis-center X projected to a separately measured visible leading/supporting boot sole Y in each final native cell; a 2D registration pivot, not reconstructed anatomical pelvis or physical ground. Fresh alpha>=64 boot-only sole segment ROIs, individually selected and measured in every final cell. TL/BL choose the leading contact; TR/BR choose the interpreted full-chain support. SE TR image-right support ROI starts X357 to exclude the nearer passing boot whose screen bottom566 is lower than selected far-support558. Rifle butt, torso, lifted/trailing boot and structural-guide coordinates are excluded. Fresh alpha>=64 minimum Y in visually selected cap-only regions in every final cell, excluding upright musket/bayonet, shoulders and roll. No cap/sole/root measurements are inherited from colored intermediates, guides or prior accepted sources. Median of four fresh final-native cap-top to individual leading/supporting-sole spans, rounded to nearest native pixel with half upward; one source-wide scale across all four phases, no per-cell or per-phase rescaling.
limitations: Acceptance binds only to this exact final-native SHA and all four independently inspected cells for local Gettysburg v15 opt-in preview.
Four discrete contact/passing illustrations are not continuous skeletal animation, proof of physical gait, verified historical marching drill or zero foot sliding.
Concealed hips/pelvis, thigh overlap, toes/heel attachment, camera-space depth and the supporting versus swinging sole assignment remain 2D model-assisted interpretations.

SE first-passing near boot projects lower in screen Y than interpreted far support boot; modest lift and depth are unresolved. Full chain and structural-reference comparison support the limited role sequence without certifying airborne/contact geometry.

Final-native cap-to-selected-sole spans are [417, 398, 417, 407] pixels; reference height 412 retains 19-pixel variation (4.61%). Posture, camera/foot depth and source body/framing variation are not separated or normalized.

The built-in color-removal edit also changed some body/framing and untargeted kit details relative to the colored intermediary. Final source was re-inspected and freshly measured; exact geometry/pixel equivalence to intermediary or native 3D guide is not claimed.

Broad gray cap/jacket, tan trousers, dark boots, brown straps, black pouches and tan roll remain compatible with Confederate A; exact face, skeleton and manufactured kit continuity is not established.
Nearly transparent red/yellow RGB residue remains untouched below alpha64; targeted padding/color checks do not establish exhaustive fringe cleanup or perfect alpha.
Model-assisted independent inspection; human, physical anatomy, historical equipment/drill, default, production and complete-family certification remain false.
Renderer temporal behavior, turn/action continuity, pause/checkpoint geometry, decoded/GPU/process residency, device performance and human usability remain separate checks.
sources.scope: Exact historical Gettysburg v15 local opt-in only; default, production, complete family, human, physical anatomy and historical drill approval remain false.
